name: NGC 5845 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5845, a compact galaxy with a rotating disk, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc5845-hubble
story: NGC 5845 is a nearby stand-in for the compact, quiet galaxies of the distant universe, with a prominent rotating disk hidden in its dense glow.

claims.text: NGC 5845 is a nearby analog of z~2 compact quiescent galaxies
NGC 5845 has a prominent rotating disk
NGC 5845 is an early-type galaxy in the AMUSE-Field sample
NGC 5845 is a target of Hubble program 12591
